$comment: THE MARKETING CONTRACT. Mirror of Notion > 'Brand, GTM & Ad Engine - Post-Fable Architecture (Jul 13)' and its Ad Bank child. Same status as tokens.json: if this file disagrees with that Notion page, the Notion page wins and this file is stale. Nothing in the pipeline may hardcode a positioning line, an angle, a stat, or a CTA. Sourced from the GTM page verbatim on 2026-09-12.

positioning.line: the 17-year-old who builds systems that make invisible things visible
positioning.throughLine: wasted food (fond), stolen attention (Stoned), unseen people
positioning.rule: One sentence, every bio, every platform. Never rewritten per-channel.

stance.note: Per GTM section 1. Personal brand = trust asset. Distribution = platform-native short video + communities + eventually paid. @getfond carousels are the distribution arm, not the credibility arm. Never conflate the two when scoring performance.

angles.name: Money leak
angles.hookSeed: Your household throws away $2,913/year. Your fridge knows which $2,913.

angles.name: Date-label lie
angles.hookSeed: 43% of tossed food was still safe. The label lied to you.
angles.valueEncapsulated: Awareness is the prerequisite for change

angles.name: Takeout guilt
angles.hookSeed: 'Nothing to eat' with $40 of ingredients in the fridge. The app that ends that sentence.

stat.note: Behavioural/experiential hook, not a numeric claim. The visual contradiction carries the argument. If a variant needs a number, borrow money-leak's EPA figure rather than inventing one.

honesty.$comment: GTM section 3: 'Every claim stays pre-launch-honest.' These are hard fails, not style notes. The engine already refuses invented statistics; this extends the same discipline to positioning claims.

ctas.$comment: Tier names mirror the Notion Design System / carousel.schema.json enum. The Design System wins on naming per CLAUDE.md precedence; this file supplies the pre-launch-honest TEXT for each tier, which the Design System does not.

Tier 0.note: Pure value post, no ask. The majority of the feed should be this.

Tier 2.text: Waitlist is open. Link in bio.

Tier 3.text: Founding member pre-order is live, $19/yr, capped at 100. Link in bio.
Tier 3.note: GTM section 3. Refundable anytime before launch. Do not restate the cap as sold-out or scarce unless the real count supports it.

postTypes.$comment: GTM section 2. Applies to the personal-brand channels; carried here because the Friday robot drafts both and must not mix registers.

voice.note: Voice rules govern generated captions and ad cards. They do NOT license rewriting carousel slide copy, which stays verbatim from the brief.

research.$comment: GTM section 2, 'Free research stack (no paid MCPs needed)'. The entropy guard draws exclusively from these. Every one is free and reachable by web search.

sources.name: Reddit search
sources.what: verbatim audience phrasing in the watering holes

sources.name: YouTube autocomplete
sources.what: the question shape people actually type

research.cadence: monthly for the angle-matrix challenge; weekly for the language bank
research.deliverable: 5 hooks that are working, 2 formats gaining, 1 dying format to avoid. Update the angle matrix if anything contradicts it.

adBank.$comment: Ad Bank page header, verbatim: 'adapt existing organic carousel/Reel copy before inventing a new angle. This bank should be 90% adaptation, not origination.'
adBank.rotationRule: Complete a full pass through every angle before starting a second pass. A second pass must change FORMAT, not just re-run the hook.
adBank.refuseOnNoMatch: If no organic carousel matches a proposed angle, report the gap. Do NOT invent an angle to fill it.

paid.$comment: GTM section 5. Stated as hard constraints because they are.
blockedReasons: Meta ad accounts require 18+. Ads run through the 18-year-old agency partner's Business Manager, with Adi as creative director.
No paid spend until founding-member revenue exists. Ads are a post-validation amplifier, never a validation tool at this budget.

testProtocol.scaleOn: landing-page conversion, UTM-tagged. Never on clicks.

organicMetrics.$comment: Per Strategy v2. These are the numbers the loop optimises. Likes are deliberately absent.
organicMetrics.primaryNote: The closest proxy for 'a stranger stopped'. Never once logged to date.
organicMetrics.sendWeightNote: Sends are weighted 3-5x likes. Using 4 as the midpoint.

killCriterion.rule: Any recurring format whose save-rate underperforms the account median for 3 consecutive posts gets redesigned or retired.
killCriterion.enforced: src/decide.mjs, not a note in a doc.
